config.name: New and dropped tracks per 5 minutes
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT at, concat(feed, ' ', kind) AS change, count() AS tracks
FROM (
  SELECT feed, bucket AS at, 'new' AS kind
  FROM (
    SELECT feed, track, bucket,
           lagInFrame(bucket, 1, toDateTime(0, 'UTC')) OVER (PARTITION BY feed, track ORDER BY bucket ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS before,
           min(bucket) OVER (PARTITION BY feed) AS first
    FROM (SELECT DISTINCT feed, track, toStartOfInterval(ts, INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) AS bucket
  FROM (
    SELECT 'air' AS feed, ts, hex AS track FROM (SELECT _timestamp AS ts,
       upper(toString(_json.hex)) AS hex,
       ifNull(nullIf(trimBoth(toString(_json.flight)), ''), upper(toString(_json.hex))) AS track,
       toFloat64OrNull(toString(_json.lat)) AS lat,
       toFloat64OrNull(toString(_json.lon)) AS lon,
       toFloat64OrNull(toString(_json.track)) AS heading,
       toFloat64OrNull(toString(_json.gs)) AS speed,
       toString(_json.alt_baro) = 'ground' AS grounded,
       toInt32OrNull(toString(_json.alt_baro)) AS altitude,
       toInt32OrNull(toString(_json.baro_rate)) AS rate,
       toString(_json.t) AS type
FROM dfe.`adsb-tracks`
WHERE $__timeFilter(_timestamp))
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'sea' AS feed, ts, track FROM (SELECT _timestamp AS ts,
       toString(_json.mmsi) AS track,
       toFloat64OrNull(toString(_json.geometry.coordinates[2])) AS lat,
       toFloat64OrNull(toString(_json.geometry.coordinates[1])) AS lon,
       toFloat64OrNull(toString(_json.properties.cog)) AS heading,
       toFloat64OrNull(toString(_json.properties.sog)) AS speed,
       toInt32OrNull(toString(_json.properties.navStat)) AS status
FROM dfe.`ais-tracks`
WHERE $__timeFilter(_timestamp))
  ))
  )
  WHERE before != bucket - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND bucket > first
  UNION ALL
  SELECT feed, bucket + INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AS at, 'dropped' AS kind
  FROM (
    SELECT feed, track, bucket,
           leadInFrame(bucket, 1, toDateTime(0, 'UTC')) OVER (PARTITION BY feed, track ORDER BY bucket ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS after,
           max(bucket) OVER (PARTITION BY feed) AS last
    FROM (SELECT DISTINCT feed, track, toStartOfInterval(ts, INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) AS bucket
  FROM (
    SELECT 'air' AS feed, ts, hex AS track FROM (SELECT _timestamp AS ts,
       upper(toString(_json.hex)) AS hex,
       ifNull(nullIf(trimBoth(toString(_json.flight)), ''), upper(toString(_json.hex))) AS track,
       toFloat64OrNull(toString(_json.lat)) AS lat,
       toFloat64OrNull(toString(_json.lon)) AS lon,
       toFloat64OrNull(toString(_json.track)) AS heading,
       toFloat64OrNull(toString(_json.gs)) AS speed,
       toString(_json.alt_baro) = 'ground' AS grounded,
       toInt32OrNull(toString(_json.alt_baro)) AS altitude,
       toInt32OrNull(toString(_json.baro_rate)) AS rate,
       toString(_json.t) AS type
FROM dfe.`adsb-tracks`
WHERE $__timeFilter(_timestamp))
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'sea' AS feed, ts, track FROM (SELECT _timestamp AS ts,
       toString(_json.mmsi) AS track,
       toFloat64OrNull(toString(_json.geometry.coordinates[2])) AS lat,
       toFloat64OrNull(toString(_json.geometry.coordinates[1])) AS lon,
       toFloat64OrNull(toString(_json.properties.cog)) AS heading,
       toFloat64OrNull(toString(_json.properties.sog)) AS speed,
       toInt32OrNull(toString(_json.properties.navStat)) AS status
FROM dfe.`ais-tracks`
WHERE $__timeFilter(_timestamp))
  ))
  )
  WHERE after != bucket + INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND bucket < last
)
GROUP BY at, change
ORDER BY at

config.name: Tracks that stopped reporting
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT feed AS "Feed",
       track AS "Track",
       formatDateTime(max(ts), '%H:%i:%S') AS "Last report (UTC)",
       dateDiff('minute', max(ts), now()) AS "Minutes since"
FROM (
  SELECT 'air' AS feed, ts, track FROM (SELECT _timestamp AS ts,
       upper(toString(_json.hex)) AS hex,
       ifNull(nullIf(trimBoth(toString(_json.flight)), ''), upper(toString(_json.hex))) AS track,
       toFloat64OrNull(toString(_json.lat)) AS lat,
       toFloat64OrNull(toString(_json.lon)) AS lon,
       toFloat64OrNull(toString(_json.track)) AS heading,
       toFloat64OrNull(toString(_json.gs)) AS speed,
       toString(_json.alt_baro) = 'ground' AS grounded,
       toInt32OrNull(toString(_json.alt_baro)) AS altitude,
       toInt32OrNull(toString(_json.baro_rate)) AS rate,
       toString(_json.t) AS type
FROM dfe.`adsb-tracks`
WHERE $__timeFilter(_timestamp))
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'sea' AS feed, ts, track FROM (SELECT _timestamp AS ts,
       toString(_json.mmsi) AS track,
       toFloat64OrNull(toString(_json.geometry.coordinates[2])) AS lat,
       toFloat64OrNull(toString(_json.geometry.coordinates[1])) AS lon,
       toFloat64OrNull(toString(_json.properties.cog)) AS heading,
       toFloat64OrNull(toString(_json.properties.sog)) AS speed,
       toInt32OrNull(toString(_json.properties.navStat)) AS status
FROM dfe.`ais-tracks`
WHERE $__timeFilter(_timestamp))
)
GROUP BY feed, track
HAVING max(ts) < now() - INTERVAL 7 MINUTE
ORDER BY max(ts) DESC
LIMIT 50

config.name: Tracks back after five minutes silent
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT feed AS "Feed",
       any(track) AS "Track",
       formatDateTime(before, '%H:%i:%S') AS "Last report before (UTC)",
       formatDateTime(ts, '%H:%i:%S') AS "Back at (UTC)",
       dateDiff('minute', before, ts) AS "Silent (min)"
FROM (
  SELECT feed, id, track, ts,
         lagInFrame(ts, 1, ts) OVER (PARTITION BY feed, id ORDER BY ts ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS before
  FROM (
    SELECT 'air' AS feed, hex AS id, track, ts FROM (SELECT _timestamp AS ts,
       upper(toString(_json.hex)) AS hex,
       ifNull(nullIf(trimBoth(toString(_json.flight)), ''), upper(toString(_json.hex))) AS track,
       toFloat64OrNull(toString(_json.lat)) AS lat,
       toFloat64OrNull(toString(_json.lon)) AS lon,
       toFloat64OrNull(toString(_json.track)) AS heading,
       toFloat64OrNull(toString(_json.gs)) AS speed,
       toString(_json.alt_baro) = 'ground' AS grounded,
       toInt32OrNull(toString(_json.alt_baro)) AS altitude,
       toInt32OrNull(toString(_json.baro_rate)) AS rate,
       toString(_json.t) AS type
FROM dfe.`adsb-tracks`
WHERE $__timeFilter(_timestamp))
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'sea' AS feed, track AS id, track, ts FROM (SELECT _timestamp AS ts,
       toString(_json.mmsi) AS track,
       toFloat64OrNull(toString(_json.geometry.coordinates[2])) AS lat,
       toFloat64OrNull(toString(_json.geometry.coordinates[1])) AS lon,
       toFloat64OrNull(toString(_json.properties.cog)) AS heading,
       toFloat64OrNull(toString(_json.properties.sog)) AS speed,
       toInt32OrNull(toString(_json.properties.navStat)) AS status
FROM dfe.`ais-tracks`
WHERE $__timeFilter(_timestamp))
  )
)
WHERE dateDiff('second', before, ts) >= 300
GROUP BY feed, id, before, ts
ORDER BY ts DESC
LIMIT 50
